jobs.description:
Your mission
 Do you love helping people and learning new things? If so, you might be the perfect fit for our Customer Care Representative position. You will be the main link between Yuh and our awesome clients, who use our app to manage their finances and investments. You will answer their questions, solve their problems, and guide them through their financial journey with Yuh.
 Key Responsabilities

• Act as a point of contact for clients, primarily handling written inquiries (chat, email, in-app messaging), and delivering a professional, friendly, and solution-oriented customer experience.

• Provide prompt, accurate, and reliable support related to the Yuh app and banking services, ensuring a high level of service quality.

• Support clients by clearly explaining products, features, and processes in an easy-to-understand and empathetic manner.

• Ensure high client satisfaction by carefully addressing requests, executing client instructions, and resolving issues with professionalism and attention to detail.

• Identify opportunities to improve the customer experience during interactions and contribute ideas to enhance services and processes.

• Accurately document client interactions in internal systems and ensure proper follow-up where required.

• Collaborate closely with the Customer Care team and other departments to ensure smooth and efficient service delivery.

• Comply with internal guidelines, regulatory requirements, and the principles of fair client treatment at all times.

Your Profile

• Currently enrolled at a university or university of applied sciences (Bachelor or Master), ideally in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field

• Strong interest in banking, fintech, and customer experience

• Excellent written communication skills and a customer-oriented mindset

• Fluent in English; German and-or French is a strong advantage

• Reliable, detail-oriented, and able to work independently

• Comfortable using digital tools and learning new systems quickly

This is a part-time job of 20%.

• Assurer une satisfaction élevée de la clientèle en répondant avec soin aux demandes, en exécutant les instructions des clients et en réglant les problèmes avec professionnalisme et attention aux détails.

• Documenter avec précision les interactions des clients dans les systèmes internes et assurer un suivi approprié au besoin.
• Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe du Service à la clientèle et d'autres ministères pour assurer une prestation de services fluide et efficace.
• Respecter en tout temps les lignes directrices internes, les exigences réglementaires et les principes d'un traitement équitable des clients. Votre profil
• Actuellement inscrit dans une université ou une université de sciences appliquées (Bachelor ou Master), idéalement en affaires, économie, finances, ou un domaine connexe
• Fort intérêt pour la banque, la fintech et l'expérience client
• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et un état d'esprit orienté vers le client
• Fluent en anglais; l'allemand et-ou le français est un fort avantage
• Fiable, orienté vers le détail et capable de travailler indépendamment
• Confortable en utilisant des outils numériques et en apprenant de nouveaux systèmes rapidement C'est un emploi à temps partiel de 20%.

titleByLocale.it: Agente Compliance aggiunto - Onboarding Private (5 mesi)
titleByLocale.en: Deputy Compliance Officer - Onboarding Private (5 months)
titleByLocale.de: Stellvertretender Compliance Officer - Onboarding Private (5 Monate)

jobs.description:
As a Deputy Compliance Officer, you will be part of the Compliance Department Onboarding team. You will be responsible for multiple tasks, which include:

• KYC and due diligence review on private clients’ account opening requests by applying Anti-Money Laundering /Counter-Terrorism Financing regulations (AMLA, AMLO-FINMA, CDB).

• Review of tax compliance aspects, such as FATCA and CRS (automatic exchange of information)

• Contribution in drafting client assessment documents and procedures

• Participation in reviews of key clients and high-risk clients

• Participation in key regulatory projects

• Participation in optimization of internal processes and guidelines

• Supporting and advising the First Line of Defense and the management.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree, preferably in Finance, Business, Laws or in Economics

• 2-3 years of experience in the Compliance field in Switzerland

• Excellent command of English and French (German is a strong asset)

• CAS in Compliance in Financial Services or similar professional qualification is considered a plus

• Excellent organizational skills combined with a high level of adaptability

• Very good communication skills

• Analytical and methodological approach

• Strong team player who enjoys working in multicultural, dynamic, technological and international environment.

This is a temporary position.

SQ2

• Review and assess account opening requests for institutional clients, primarily for operating companies, financial institutions and other external partners, with a focus on AML/CTF, sanctions, reputational, tax compliance and cross-border risks.

 Payroll Management

• Ensure compliance with local labor laws, tax regulations, and social security requirements.

• Act as the main point of contact for payroll-related queries.

• Drive automation initiatives to increase efficiency and reduce manual work.

• Document and standardize payroll and compensation processes.

• Collaborate with HRIS teams to optimize systems and workflows.

Compensation & Benefits

• Contribute to salary benchmarking and market analysis.

• Help design and maintain salary grids and compensation structures.

• Partner with Talent Management on compensation reviews and cycles.

Budget & Reporting

• Monitor payroll and compensation budgets in collaboration with Finance.

• Prepare regular reports and dashboards (headcount, payroll costs, compensation analysis).

• Provide insights and recommendations to support decision-making.

Experience & Skills

• 5+ years of experience in payroll, ideally in an international or fast-paced environment.

• Strong knowledge of payroll processes, accounting principles, and compliance.

• Strong knowledge of Swiss payroll and Swiss labor laws & regulations.

• Genuine interest in Compensation & Benefits topics and a willingness to develop expertise in this area.

• Experience with payroll systems and HRIS.

• Solid analytical skills with strong attention to detail.

• Exposure to Compensation & Benefits topics (benchmarking, salary structures, bonus schemes) is a strong plus.
